note: New spec (docs/specs/critique.md): pass 2 of the reference map ranks the stored locators against a fresh reference of the item's current lines and tries the closest first. The Deno tool passed the item's raw text as rank target (never a reference), so the stored order won: the coarse locator stored first took the id (rvw_coarse); the item's own locator now wins (rvw_own).
